name: Qingdao CHOHO Industrial Co.,Ltd.
summary: Qingdao CHOHO Industrial Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of chain transmission systems in China and internationally. It operates through three segments: Transmission Systems; Agricultural Machinery Transmission and Conveyor Systems; and Industrial Equipment Transmission and Conveyor Systems. The company offers engine chain systems, including automotive, motorcycle, and other engine chains; industrial chain systems, such as driving, conveyor, leaf, engineering, and special chains, as well as industrial sprockets and links; and agricultural machinery chain systems comprising agricultural chains, chain assemblies, chain links, and machinery sprockets.
